meta.notes: PERFORMANCE-STANDARD §2 schema. The regression metrics are the worst page across perf/lighthouse.json's paths: the lowest performance score, the slowest LCP, the heaviest page. null = not applicable here: p95_ms (k6; the site is static files on GitHub Pages, no route of ours runs), llm_* (no LLM), js_kb_gzip (no external script; the only script is an inline loader counted in the page weight). CLS and TBT are gated by absolute budgets only: in CI they measure 0 to 0.005 and 0 ms, and 10% of (nearly) zero is not a usable tolerance.
